youtube_description:
We met up with Tony McGovern, guitarist of international multi-platinum band Texas, up in Glasgow at the iconic Gorbals Studios to chat with him about the history of the band, his career highlights and why he chose the Artisan 30 as his go-to amplifier. 

Watch the full interview here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ArkGsOE9ixI
youtube_title: Tony McGovern, guitarist of Texas, on why the Artisan 30 is his go-to amp.
